ask-less-attention-budgets.description: Treat user attention as a budget. Memory-guided review decides which clarifying questions justify another interruption.

attrify-soft-attribute-clarification.description: Make ambiguous preferences inspectable: clarify soft attributes, then let people accept, reject and refine executable interpretations.

safe-pro-cross-modal-inquiry.description: Risk-conditioned uncertainty guides when to ask. Safety and cross-modal ambiguity constrain proactive clarification.

halo-human-grounded-proactivity.description: Human-grounded evaluation of whether to help, when to intervene and how far to go. Useful initiative must be distinguished from overreach.
